slides.title: What changed for A3
slides.script: The SAP API partly fits. [pause] We kept the refund process, used sample journeys, and saved SAP financial references. These are our Option Two changes.
sources: INFOSYS 704 A3 specification V3: Option 2 requires details of changes for partial SAP API fit.
Group A3 adapts one member’s individual A2 refund-preparation proposal and TO-BE model. The wider group theme includes other disruption tasks.
Journeys use synthetic fixtures. Credit Memo Request provides read-only SAP financial context. The case checklist, route and queue remain local application records.

slides.title: SAP financial reference
slides.script: The app reads Credit Memo Request through a personal SAP account. [pause] Staff save its source, time, and reference note. Booking payment remains unverified.
sources: https://api.sap.com/api/sap-s4-CE_CREDITMEMOREQUEST_0001-v1/overview
SAP public sandbox record 60000002, read using the personal API account. Generic financial context, not an airline booking, paid fare or approved refund.

Native table transcribes the actual saved response shown in outputs/A3_App_V1/screenshots/V1_4/sap-case-reference.png. Document 60000002, net USD 1,000.00, preceding 60000001, process C raw code, approval not supplied; read-only GET captured 9 Oct 2026 at 12:35 pm. Booking match not verified; payment verification not performed.
Source and capture time belong to the saved reference. Staff retain manual eligibility and amount checks.

slides.title: From request to handoff
slides.script: Here is a saved request. [pause] Missing checks block handoff. [pause for demo] I add the SAP reference. The checks stay unchanged. [pause for demo] I record and save the manual review. [pause for demo] Now I send the case to its queue. [pause for demo] Tracking shows the same status. The refund decision remains pending.
sources: Actual V1.4 browser captures on 2026-10-09. Initial-state example AF-A5B5BA84B950 v0 shows incomplete review and disabled handoff. Prepared-stage example AF-CC7A93DA2007 v2 shows saved manual review ready for the standard queue.

The main acceptance case AF-CC7A93DA2007 retained all three manual checks as false after personal SAP GET 60000002 at v1. Staff saved those checks at v2, handed off at v3, reopened with a reason at v4, saved specialist review at v5 and handed off to the specialist queue at v6. Tracking and downloadable receipt use the same persisted record.
The app records a local review queue, not a SAP refund posting or payment.

slides.title: Review status and recovery
slides.script: Staff see saved status beside review actions. [pause] Draft recovery and version warnings protect work. Complex cases show their specialist and queue.
sources: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ten-usability-heuristics/

Implemented status visibility, real-world booking language, Back/Edit/Reopen controls, shared navigation, acknowledgement and handoff prevention, visible checklists, saved-request shortcut, focused pages, clear errors, draft recovery and field help.
The mobile capture demonstrates responsive browser layout.
